facts.text: The New Mexico Opportunity Scholarship covers up to 100% of tuition and required fees for eligible New Mexico resident students taking at least 12 credit hours.

sources.title: NM Opportunity Scholarship - | New Mexico State University - BE ...
sources.quote: The State of New Mexico currently has two different NM Opportunity scholarships that assist in covering up to 100% tuition and required fees, as well as up to $50 per credit hour for course-specific fees.
